sloka: नृत्त वादित्र कुशला राक्षस इन्द्र भुज अन्कगाः ।वर आभरण धारिण्यो निषन्ना दद्र्शे कपिः ॥५-१०-३२॥
transliteration: nṛtta vāditra kuśalā rākṣasa indra bhuja ankagāḥ ।vara ābharaṇa dhāriṇyo niṣannā dadrśe kapiḥ ॥5-10-32॥

translations.english: Hanuman saw the women there wearing fine jewellery, performing dances, playing musical instruments, and resting on the lap or leaning on the arms of the demon king.
